doc: Read, edit, step and replay the Inspector's cellular material field.

tools.name: cellular.describe
tools.description: Discover the integer rule project format, budgets and editing SOP.

tools.name: cellular.snapshot
tools.description: Read revision, simulation tick, replay frame, brushes and current state hash.

tools.name: cellular.project
tools.description: Export the current state as a reloadable cellular project; history is not serialized.

tools.name: cellular.config
tools.description: Read editable rules, palette, brushes, rate and boundary.

tools.name: cellular.inspect
tools.description: Read all channels of one cell at x/y.

tools.name: cellular.load
tools.description: Validate and load a project atomically; starts a new replay history.
tools.undo: ui.undo restores the field before it

revision.description: the revision it was read at (stale ones are refused)

tools.name: cellular.configure
tools.description: Validate an edited rule/palette configuration over the current field.
tools.undo: ui.undo restores the configuration before it

config.description: name, rate, boundary, rules, palette and/or brushes

tools.name: cellular.paint
tools.description: Paint an integer-radius brush at x/y; records an input without advancing simulation time.
tools.undo: ui.undo restores the cells before it

tools.name: cellular.advance
tools.description: Advance 1..120 fixed simulation steps; retained history can be sought.
tools.undo: cellular.seek to the frame cellular.snapshot read before

tools.name: cellular.seek
tools.description: Restore a retained replay frame exactly, including paint inputs.

tools.name: cellular.reset
tools.description: Restore this project's initial state; starts a new replay history.
tools.undo: ui.undo restores the field before it

tools.name: cellular.play
tools.description: Start or stop live playback; continuation rechecks the initiating Agent authority.
